metadata.name: 3D Model Quality Schema
metadata.description: Quality gate schema for 3D model assets. Ensures polygon budgets, LOD requirements, and coordinate system documentation are met before assets are approved for use.

description: Quality requirements for 3D model assets including polygon limits, LOD levels, and coordinate system.

polygon_count.description: Total polygon count for the model

coordinate_system.description: Coordinate reference system used by the model

units.description: Unit of measurement for model geometry

lod_levels.description: Number of Level of Detail variants provided

texture_resolution_max.description: Maximum texture resolution in pixels (width or height)

has_collision_mesh.description: Whether a collision/physics mesh is included

source_application.description: Application used to create the model (e.g., Blender, Maya, Revit)

export_format_version.description: Version of the export format (e.g., glTF 2.0, USD 23.05)
